title.en: Reconstituting the Board of Directors of the National Cottage Industries Development Authority

text.en:
The Board of Directors of the National Cottage Industries Development Authority is hereby
reconstituted to be composed of the following or their representatives:
(1) Minister of Industry as Chairman
(2) Minister of Trade as Vice-Chairman
(3) Minister of Human Settlements
(4) Minister of Education and Culture
(5) Chairman of the National Manpower and Youth Council
(6) Governor of the Central Bank of the Philippines
(7) Chairman of the Development Bank of the Philippines
(8) Administrator of the National Cottage Industries Development Authority
(9) Three (3) representatives from the private sector
The three (3) members from the private sector shall be appointed by the President for a term of six years:
Provided, That one shall be initially appointed for a term of six years, one for a term of four years and the
other one for a term of two years.

All laws, decrees, charters, executive orders, administrative orders, proclamations, rules and
regulations or parts thereof that are in conflict with this Executive Order are hereby repealed or modified
accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 18th day of March, in the year of Our Lord, Nineteen Hundred and Eighty.
